issues.reason: Adjective+noun fusion is licensed only when the pair 'names a recognized kind' (term of art, origin, role title, material adjective) and 'never for incidental description'; 'neighboring station' is a context-relative description of which stations, not a subtype, so on a plural the modifier must distribute over the members and the invented kind neighboring_station (with its Inheritance atoms) asserts a classification the text does not state.

Conditional on fusion, 'neighboring' is a participial positional adjective predicable of the stations at least as readily as 'east' of 'wing', which the instruction set counts as passing the test, so exposure would be the determined choice — the 'assistant secretary' bar is for rank adjectives that cannot be predicated at all.

A bare (non-definite) trigger participant takes the whenever route's plain-variable premise ('when a bearing seizes') with its restriction as a premise conjunct (the 'stray dogs' pattern), so the top-level (Member sk_activity_1 wraith_activity) and (LocatedIn sk_activity_1 sunken_cove) assert a standing existence and location of wraith activity at the Cove that the sentence only conditions on — 'Assert only what the text states'.

gaps_confirmed: a distributive predicate over a definite plural group inside a whenever-rule consequent: doctrine wants the group event plus a per-member (PartOf $x <group>) rule, and nothing states where that inner rule goes inside another rule's conclusion
new_gaps: a locative restrictor on a bare eventuality-denoting mass noun ('wraith activity at the Cove'): whether it takes the thing-head LocatedIn or the eventuality-head Location is undecided, and its placement as a premise conjunct is only inferable from the 'stray dogs' restriction-as-premise pattern
defect_summary: Issue 0: (GroupOf sk_stations_1 station) plus (Implication (PartOf $x sk_stations_1) (Member $x neighboring)) (STV 1.0 0.9), with no neighboring_station symbol or decomposition atoms. Issue 2: the trigger participant as a plain variable in the premise — (And (Member $a wraith_activity) (LocatedIn $a sunken_cove) (Member $e1 increase) (Theme $e1 $a)) — with sunken_cove typed and named at top level and the definitional (Inheritance wraith_activity activity) kept, asserting no activity witness (LocatedIn versus Location on the restrictor is itself a gap).
notes: Theme for the scalar-change subject, Source for 'from the Council', the un-Named capitalized collective 'the Council', the bare-kind Theme feather_ration with its genus, and the During-linked Skolem request event are to spec.
